gaps.gap: Scripted Essential Graphics setup is unverified for the control types the audits rely on: about 20 dropdowns (Theme, Layout, Side, Subline, Style, Position, Card scheme, Glyph…), plus Point, Scale and Angle. The courses, SMM and podcast audits also assume ExtendScript importMGT/getMGTComponent. Deciding facts: only ExtendScript can set MOGRT text on Pr ≤26.x (if the spike confirms it); only CEP installs without Creative Cloud desktop or an Adobe login; Premiere CEP is default-off from Dec 2028.
